WHY POULTRY CALCIUM

A specific need.
One promising
local input.

Every egg requires calcium. Supplemental shell calcium is commonly offered alongside a complete layer diet, giving laying birds access to an additional calcium source.

Our goal is to develop a controlled, locally processed shell material for that established product category. The product is still being tested; final specifications and feeding guidance are not yet published.

A supplement to a complete layer diet, not a complete feed.
